blurb: Guests take airboat tours through shallow waters, mangrove tunnels, and marshlands to see wildlife and learn about the local ecosystem and culture. Tours range from 1 hour to 1.5 hours, with options for group tours and extended fishing charters. Some tours include snorkeling in about 6 ft of water to see coral and sponges.
extraNote: Book in advance; tours can fill quickly especially in peak seasons · St. Martins Marina office, bottom floor, 2355 S Ripple Path, Ozello, FL
